mechanism_narrative: A positive monthly change in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals rising inflation expectations, which typically lead to reduced equity valuations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the months where CPIAUCSL shows a positive monthly change, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases the cost of capital and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) and a decline in real GDP (GDPC1) from the previous quarter signals an imminent recession, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.0% AND GDPC1 decline from prior quarter
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by 3 consecutive months of rising FEDFUNDS), a rise in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and the monetary tightening cycle regime condition is met, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive monthly change in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 0.5% signals a strengthening housing market and broader economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when HOUST change > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) signals a robust housing market and strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive monthly change in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the months where INDPRO shows a positive monthly change, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5% signals a strengthening labor market and rising consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when PAYEMS change > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
